subject: Future Tech
title: Fusion and Climate Change
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Fusion and Climate Change.

hook.text: Energy production causes 73% of global emissions.

buildup.text: Fusion emits zero CO2 during operation. Its fuel is seawater. A fusion grid eliminates the biggest source of emissions.

discovery.text: Cheap fusion energy also enables carbon capture, green hydrogen, and electric everything—amplifying climate benefits.

climax.text: Fusion won't save the 2030 targets, but it could anchor a fully decarbonized world by 2060.

punchline.text: Renewables win the sprint. Fusion wins the marathon.

quiz.question: What percentage of global emissions comes from energy production?
